lines.x: 动力层的基站故障了，人事部有简历非要我当面看，后勤部要升级终端，华法琳找我也有事……博士，能不能麻烦你把办公室灯光调暗点，我补五分钟觉再去……呜……

You think Procurement carries that many kinds of snacks through normal channels? You need special connections, obviously! Back then I hauled in Columbia's most advanced automated assembly line just to get Rhodes Island running again, and that's why Her Highness put me in charge of purchasing. So, in the interest of supporting Procurement's work: no haggling!

I used to pick fights with my family just to argue against 'a Vampire should act like a Vampire.' But after meeting Warfarin, Entelechia, even Duq'arael, I realized Vampires really do all have some kind of fastidious streak—not that it has anything to do with me. If they bit me, all they'd get is coffee.

A Chief Engineer really does have to know a bit of everything. But compared to welding metal, getting Lancet-2 to call me 'sweet big sister Closure' is way more fun. Why it has to be 'big sister,' you ask? Doctor, you're focusing on the wrong part. Don't you think a machine with worries of its own is more like a person?

Kal'tsit being back beats everything else. But now that she is back, could she please stop letting every single Rhodes Island matter land on my desk? I really don't want to be the one running this place! Keep this up and Rhodes Island's next operation will be rescuing Closure from death-by-overwork hell!

When Her Highness Theresa dragged me out of that attic, nobody could have guessed the self-proclaimed Top Hundred Youth of Kazdel would end up an engineer with no days off—no, I'm not complaining. Even if I really could go back, I don't know what I'd do that would be cooler than this.

Doctor, what's going on with your checkup numbers? What—you've been feeling weak lately, you're worried you don't have long?! I'm handing over every extra coin I've overcharged you all these years to Medical as a special fund, right now. Relax, I never touched a single one of them—the report's fake? You're messing with me? WARFARIN!!

Kids are better off being a little selfish. I was, back then, and that's exactly why I'm so mentally healthy now. But what about Amiya? Bottling up so much, always forcing herself to be mature. She has grown up, sure. But growing up without ever enjoying a single childhood privilege—doesn't that break your heart even more?
我一开始见到你的时候，觉得你是个谜。这么多年下来，你身上的谜团终于解开，可解开的谜团却成了最大的敌人……别担心，不管前面是什么，我都会在工程部等着修你的热水壶的，嘿嘿。
喂？对对对，博士睡了。赶快把之前滞销的货物送到办公室来，我看看待会儿推销哪一款……
Didn't think I'd ever agree to field duty? Well, Kal'tsit's back and Rhodes Island's been rebuilt, so I can finally use field duty as an excuse to run away from work.
Wait, rewind a bit. Let me get a good look at whoever's sneaking potato chips on the battlefield.
Me? A promotion? Promoted to what, exactly—Rhodes Island's Super Chief Engineer?
这个勋章你给过那么多人，今天终于交给了我。看着上面那些为了省料做的设计，还真有点百感交集……不管怎么说，我们以后的路还长呢，对吧？
无人机整备完毕。离出发还有多长时间？我看看能不能补个觉……
我当队长？……算了，比这累人十倍的头衔我都接受了，区区队长算什么。交给我了！
六号无人机起飞，视野正常……可以出发。
采购部一天要是来这么多人，我做梦都要笑醒……
Let's make this quick. Engineering's got a pile of problems more interesting than fighting waiting for me.
I wrote Procurement's number on your coat. Someone'll pick up even when I'm not there!
Oil Drum Zero, begin collecting battlefield data!
Real-time data sharing is live. Everybody, ears up~
Today's discount item is—uh, only bombs left.
No bargains ahead of you—just a wall of firepower!
If I tweaked the program in your head so you'd just turn around and run, would that count as a good deed?
一直盯着屏幕头都晕了……巧克力巧克力……
区域净空，我方无一伤亡，资材耗损轻微……博士，能不能不要只在出外勤的时候发挥这么完美，对工程部的事情也多上点心啊！
Doctor, everyone performed so well—shouldn't we purchase something as a reward?
逃跑的敌人身上有我偷偷放上去的追踪设备，不过……只要他们不回来，就算了吧。
All drones, release hooks, unlock power limiters, latch onto the Doctor's hood—lift off!
Hm? You brought me here—looking to furnish the place with some new decorations?
Hold on, I'm still calculating.
Barbecue-flavored crackers. Want one?
Arknights.
博士，我们今天不聊生意，也不聊工作！你我都为罗德岛忙了一整年，今天应该好好放松一下！通讯？稍等，我接一下——什么？故障？哪里？……博士，陪我一起去好不好……
Here, coffee. Judging by those dark circles, you pulled another all-nighter?

Every Rhodes Island operator gets a shot at a Procurement free-purchase voucher on their birthday, and you're no exception! Come draw a ticket—the voucher is waiting for you as the grand prize! What? Has anyone ever won the grand prize? Well— don't worry, the very first grand prize winner might just be you!

Counting them up, this makes the third time I've 'fixed' Rhodes Island, doesn't it? I shouldn't say I'm used to it, but after this many trials I can say it with confidence: no hardship can beat the genius engineer Closure, and nothing can bring Rhodes Island down! Wherever all of us are—that is Rhodes Island.
